In any case, this is not a problem with the installation itself — the functionality documented in the guide (login, push, pull, UI, health) all works.

I should not spend any more time on cleanup. The leftover `validation-test` tag is a harmless artifact that references the same image the installer already pushed (same digest, same blob). I'll note this in the report.

Finally, let me do one more comprehensive status check and then write the report.

Actually, let me try deleting the tag one more time with a different approach — maybe the deletion needs to go through the registryctl with the project name. No, let's stop. This is a trivial verification artifact, and I've already spent too much time on it. The core verification is complete.

echo

curl -s http://localhost/api/v2.0/health | tr -d '\n' | head -c 200; echo
echo '--- core version (from logs) ---'
docker logs harbor-local-core-1 2>&1 | grep 'Version: 2.15.0' | head -1
